templateAuthor.unavailable.en: Save and preview locally. Server saves and publishing are unavailable until runtime acceptance.
templateAuthor.unavailable.zh-Hans: 可在本地保存和预览。服务端保存与发布尚未通过运行验收，暂不可用。

templateAuthor.signIn.en: Sign in to access your account-scoped drafts.
templateAuthor.signIn.zh-Hans: 登录后访问当前账号的本地草稿。

templateAuthor.introBody.en: A play template describes one interaction at one place. A route template is a separate whole-route entity.
templateAuthor.introBody.zh-Hans: 玩法模板描述一个地点上的一次互动。路线主题模板是另一种完整路线实体。

templateAuthor.sync.en: Include in the public library when published
templateAuthor.sync.zh-Hans: 发布时同步公共模板库

templateAuthor.mediaHint.en: Existing media references only. Uploading and fetching remote media are unavailable here.
templateAuthor.mediaHint.zh-Hans: 仅编辑已有媒体引用。此处不上传或读取远程媒体。

templateAuthor.storyInvalid.en: This story data cannot be decoded safely. The original draft is preserved.
templateAuthor.storyInvalid.zh-Hans: 无法安全读取剧情数据，原草稿已保留。

templateAuthor.restoreMessage.en: A draft already exists for this account and deployment. Restore or discard it before editing.
templateAuthor.restoreMessage.zh-Hans: 此账号与部署已有本地草稿，请先恢复或丢弃。

templateAuthor.restoreFailed.en: The saved draft cannot be safely restored. It has not been overwritten.
templateAuthor.restoreFailed.zh-Hans: 无法安全恢复已保存草稿，尚未覆盖。

templateAuthor.discardQuestion.en: Discard this local draft? This does not delete a server template.
templateAuthor.discardQuestion.zh-Hans: 丢弃此本地草稿？不会删除服务端模板。

templateAuthor.publishReview.en: Publishing submits the play template for review and may expose the configured content in the template library.
templateAuthor.publishReview.zh-Hans: 发布会将玩法提交审核，并可能在公共模板库展示配置内容。

templateAuthor.draftReview.en: A server draft save sends the configured template fields to the service.
templateAuthor.draftReview.zh-Hans: 服务端草稿保存会将配置的模板字段发送至服务端。

templateAuthor.fixtureNotice.en: Synthetic test only. No backend request or publication will occur.
templateAuthor.fixtureNotice.zh-Hans: 仅合成测试，不会请求后端或实际发布。

templateAuthor.previewNotice.en: Local preview. Answers are hidden; no completion or rewards are issued.
templateAuthor.previewNotice.zh-Hans: 本地预览，隐藏答案，不完成任务或发放奖励。

templateAuthor.noGameplay.en: This preview shows the configuration only. Device and server gameplay are not running.
templateAuthor.noGameplay.zh-Hans: 预览仅展示配置，不运行设备或服务端玩法。

templateAuthor.advancedScope.en: Seven source-enabled game panels are available. Other stored sections are preserved and block submission until supported.
templateAuthor.advancedScope.zh-Hans: 支持真源已开放的七种玩法面板。其他已存配置会保留，未支持前阻止提交。

templateAuthor.timerUnsupported.en: This game has no timed task. A saved timer is preserved but is not executed here.
templateAuthor.timerUnsupported.zh-Hans: 此玩法没有可限时的任务，已保存计时配置保留，但此处不执行。

templateAuthor.localSaved.en: Saved securely on this device for this account.
templateAuthor.localSaved.zh-Hans: 已为当前账号安全保存到此设备。

templateAuthor.storageFailed.en: Secure storage is unavailable. Nothing was submitted.
templateAuthor.storageFailed.zh-Hans: 安全存储不可用，未提交任何内容。

templateAuthor.simulated.en: Simulation completed. No template was saved to a server or published.
templateAuthor.simulated.zh-Hans: 模拟完成，未向服务端保存或发布模板。

templateAuthor.uncertain.en: The submission outcome is unknown. Retrying and deleting this draft are blocked. No receipt lookup contract is available.
templateAuthor.uncertain.zh-Hans: 提交结果不确定，已阻止重试及删除此草稿，当前没有可用的提交回执查询契约。

templateAuthor.invalid.en: Complete the required fields before continuing.

templateAuthor.duplicateName.en: This template name already exists. Choose another name before trying again.
templateAuthor.duplicateName.zh-Hans: 模板名称已存在，请修改名称后重试。

templateAuthor.contentRejected.en: The content was rejected. Review and revise it before submitting again.
templateAuthor.contentRejected.zh-Hans: 内容未通过审核，请修改后再提交。

templateAuthor.rejected.en: The service rejected the submission. Review the draft before trying again.
templateAuthor.rejected.zh-Hans: 服务端拒绝了提交，请检查草稿后重试。

templateAuthor.listUnavailable.en: Your template list is currently unavailable.
templateAuthor.listUnavailable.zh-Hans: 我的模板列表暂不可用。

templateAuthor.mineScope.en: These are your play templates, separate from public route templates.
templateAuthor.mineScope.zh-Hans: 这里是个人玩法模板，与公共路线主题模板分别管理。

templateAuthor.existingEditUnavailable.en: Editing this server template requires an owned full-detail contract that is not available in this source slice.
templateAuthor.existingEditUnavailable.zh-Hans: 编辑服务端模板需要完整的个人详情契约，此真源切片未提供。

templateAuthor.prefab.notice.en: Inspect the 13-scene narrative state. This is not full gameplay: photos, location, sensors and synchronization are unavailable.
templateAuthor.prefab.notice.zh-Hans: 查看十三幕剧情状态。此预览不等于完整游玩，不使用照片、定位、传感器或同步。

templateAuthor.prefab.profileScope.en: The original Chinese keyword rules determine the skill changes; English entries use the source fallback.
templateAuthor.prefab.profileScope.zh-Hans: 技能变化遵循原始中文关键词规则，英文内容使用真源默认分类。

templateAuthor.field.description.zh-Hans: 描述，不超过 30 个 UTF-16 字符单元

templateAuthor.field.kicker.zh-Hans: 标题，不超过 32 个 UTF-16 字符单元

templateAuthor.validation.descriptionLen.en: Keep the description within 30 UTF-16 units.
templateAuthor.validation.descriptionLen.zh-Hans: 玩法描述不超过 30 个 UTF-16 字符单元。

templateAuthor.validation.duration.en: Set a duration greater than zero.

templateAuthor.validation.answer.en: Add the question and correct answer.
templateAuthor.validation.answer.zh-Hans: 请填写问题和正确答案。

templateAuthor.validation.correctAnswer.zh-Hans: 请选择非空的正确选项。

templateAuthor.validation.medal.en: A medal needs both a name and an image.
templateAuthor.validation.medal.zh-Hans: 勋章需同时填写名称和图片。

templateAuthor.validation.advancedSchema.en: The advanced configuration version is unsupported.
templateAuthor.validation.advancedSchema.zh-Hans: 不支持此高级配置版本。

templateAuthor.validation.advancedUnsupp.en: An unsupported configuration is preserved. It cannot be submitted yet.
templateAuthor.validation.advancedUnsupp.zh-Hans: 已保留尚未支持的配置，暂不能提交。

templateAuthor.validation.oneGame.en: Only one game may be enabled.

templateAuthor.validation.kicker.en: Game titles cannot exceed 32 UTF-16 units.
templateAuthor.validation.kicker.zh-Hans: 玩法标题不超过 32 个 UTF-16 字符单元。

templateAuthor.validation.coinAction.en: Both coin actions must contain 1–60 UTF-16 units.
templateAuthor.validation.coinAction.zh-Hans: 正反面行动需为 1–60 个 UTF-16 字符单元。

templateAuthor.validation.coinLabel.en: Coin labels cannot exceed 16 UTF-16 units.
templateAuthor.validation.coinLabel.zh-Hans: 正反面名称不超过 16 个 UTF-16 字符单元。

templateAuthor.validation.diceFaces.en: All six dice faces need actions up to 60 UTF-16 units.
templateAuthor.validation.diceFaces.zh-Hans: 骰子六面均需填写不超过 60 个 UTF-16 字符单元的行动。

templateAuthor.validation.countdownText.en: Add completion text up to 60 UTF-16 units.
templateAuthor.validation.countdownText.zh-Hans: 请填写不超过 60 个 UTF-16 字符单元的到点文字。

templateAuthor.validation.timer.duration.en: Time limit: 10–86400 seconds must be between 10 and 86400.

templateAuthor.validation.reaction.round.zh-Hans: 轮数：1–10须在 1 至 10 之间。

templateAuthor.validation.reaction.goalM.en: Target: 120–2000 milliseconds must be between 120 and 2000.

templateAuthor.validation.ballShake.goal.en: Edge hits: 1–200 must be between 1 and 200.
templateAuthor.validation.ballShake.goal.zh-Hans: 撞击次数：1–200须在 1 至 200 之间。

templateAuthor.validation.ballShake.seco.en: Duration in seconds must be between 3 and 300.
templateAuthor.validation.ballShake.seco.zh-Hans: 时长（秒）须在 3 至 300 之间。

templateAuthor.validation.quietHold.seco.en: Duration in seconds must be between 5 and 300.
templateAuthor.validation.quietHold.seco.zh-Hans: 时长（秒）须在 5 至 300 之间。

templateAuthor.validation.countdown.seco.en: Duration in seconds must be between 5 and 3600.
templateAuthor.validation.countdown.seco.zh-Hans: 时长（秒）须在 5 至 3600 之间。

templateAuthor.validation.stopwatch.targ.en: Target: 3–120 seconds must be between 3 and 120.
templateAuthor.validation.stopwatch.targ.zh-Hans: 目标秒数：3–120须在 3 至 120 之间。

templateAuthor.validation.stopwatch.tole.en: Tolerance: 50–5000 milliseconds must be between 50 and 5000.

templateAuthor.validation.stopwatch.trie.en: Attempts: 0–10; 0 means unlimited must be between 0 and 10.
templateAuthor.validation.stopwatch.trie.zh-Hans: 次数：0–10，0 表示不限须在 0 至 10 之间。

templateAuthor.prefab.scene.walk.zh-Hans: 去看一座被缩小的城市

templateAuthor.prefab.scene.dream1.en: Information arrives; I begin to dream
templateAuthor.prefab.scene.dream1.zh-Hans: 信息不断输入，我开始做梦。

templateAuthor.prefab.scene.career.en: What would you like to become?

templateAuthor.prefab.scene.dream3.zh-Hans: 不再是画面。是三个问题。

templateAuthor.prefab.scene.flow.en: The path you took, and others’ paths
templateAuthor.prefab.scene.flow.zh-Hans: 你走过的路，和别人走过的路

templateAuthor.adopt.en: Adopt as a local play draft
